card.name: Words before lab-test and metabolite terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (using, the, to, and, for, include) just before a lab method, urine test or drug metabolite name. Also fires on number pieces in half-life ranges.

modes.label: Linking word before lab method
modes.description: A word like using, the or for right before a named assay or urine test.
modes.example: urinary vanillylmandelic acid (VMA)<< using>> the Gitlow method.

modes.label: Before metabolite or steroid names
modes.description: A joining word such as to or and ahead of a metabolite or steroid measurement.
modes.example: a CYP2D6 model substrate,<< to>> its major metabolite, dextror

modes.label: Digits in half-life ranges
modes.description: Part of a number inside a range of hours.
